lineage.description: People in need figures were compiled from direct observational data and anecdotal reports collected through the 2020 Humanitarian Profile and Cluster assessment process by OCHA Sudan. Data were aggregated by sector and administrative locality (Admin level 2) to produce PIN estimates and severity classifications for humanitarian response planning.
